source.label: Positivity relaxed in a window with a count; an averaged weighted count of zeros

reviewer: Claude Code proof assessment; fresh medium reviewer

claims.summary: For continuous even real g of compact support with integrable boundary function phi >= -eta: u = Re h satisfies u + eta >= cos(pi y) cos(pi delta) exp(-pi|gamma - gamma0|)(u(gamma0 + i delta) + eta) in the strip. If also u >= 0 outside a window around gamma0 and the sum of u over a multiset Z is at most B, then c u(gamma0 + i delta) > B + eta N with N at least the number of points of Z in the window forces cos(pi delta) D_W < c. And from N(t,t+1) <= A0 log(|t|+3), N(T,2T) = (T/2pi) l(T) + O(log T) and an on-line fraction kappa on (T+1, 2T-1], the window's weighted count D_W is at least m_W(T)/2, about (1 - exp(-pi min(W,1))) kappa log T/(2 pi^2), on a subset of [T,2T] of measure at least T m_W(T)/(8 A0 log(2T+4)).
claims.assessment: Working elementary proofs: the previous obstruction applied to u + eta, and an averaging argument. Shows, in the model of one depth and one count, that relaxing the positivity near the point gains nothing, and derives an averaged count from two classical statements as assumed in the density project's hypothesis file; no obstruction for windows shorter than about 1/log T; nonvacuity of the relaxed class not shown. The on-line fraction is a hypothesis; the density import reports one, unaudited.
claims.rationale: Extends the limit of explicit-formula certificates to one model of relaxed positivity (one depth, one count for the window) and gives the count a derivation from stated hypotheses; other count-only models and weaker hypotheses on the window's zeros are open.
claims.next_action: Extend part 2 to depths and counts on sub-regions, exhibit or exclude an admissible function of the relaxed class, and state what bound on off-line zeros of the window an intermediate certificate needs.
claims.formalization_scope: Not formalized; no Lean work assigned.

notes.mathematical_status: Complete proofs in the entry; part 3 conditional on its three stated hypotheses.
notes.significance: Context: an obstruction to a method. Novelty not claimed.
notes.relationships: Extends the strip positivity obstruction to relaxed positivity and supplies its count.

relationships: Uses its Poisson representation and kernel inequality.
With eta = 0 and the window the whole line it is that lemma's part 3.
Part 3's on-line fraction is of the kind that import reports; its hypothesis file supplies the two count statements.
